author: jerryernst
quote:
Genuinely one of the best games I've played in a long time.

The story and writing, art, music, themes, characters, worldbuilding, and even combat system all combined into a true masterpiece. 

Atlas has proven time and time again they are the true kings of the JRPG genre, and this very much feels like a loveletter to Final Fantasy fans who have been burned by Square Enix as of late.

author: jerryernst
quote: Just a taste of the customer support we are likely to see:I dropped my controller while creating my name and accidentally hit square, confirming a nonsensical half-finished name without any prompt asking "are you sure" or anything like that.I contacted support just for them to almost literally say "do it yourself in game" knowing damn well that means a forced $5. They make it this easy to goof on purpose and then sell you the solution. This is also in line with their skins costing more than several amazing indie or even AAA game do.

quote: I adored the first so this is genuinely one of the most disappointing games I've played. Decided to quit and sell it after 30 hours, which felt miserable and wasted. This game 100% doesn't respect your tine and makes you feel bad every chance it gets with its cranked up terrible rng.

quote: This is a prime example of making a product vs making a piece of art. They opted for mass appeal, dumbing everything downtown wish dot com Disney levels of dialogue and characters.

author: jerryernst
quote: Just finished Spiderman 2 (game) and it might be the best non-comic spiderman story. The story was 10/10, and while they played it safe in some aspects, they were untelligent and took what absolutely worked making it better than it has been. Im also mostly sick of open world Bethesda style games, but this wasn't as annoying as it could have been and absolutely acceptable while making sense given how fun it is to swing around. I think it should definitely be in the running for goty.

author: jerryernst
quote: Absolutely incredible game. Truly reminds me that games are still art, and I hope it reminds other devs this too

author: jerryernst
quote: Genuinely a terrible game in almost every aspect. It's all flash and no substance with bad writing made worse by some of the worst pacing issues in any media. I'm putting a zero because I fully believe this game is not worth playing, and a month after beating it I have not thought about it a single time other than right now to check if the hype died down yet and people came to their senses.

author: jerryernst
quote:
This is a rare game that I will just never complete. For every great thing about it there's a hoard of BS mechanics and a load of RNG to disrespect the players time. I'm even save scumming and I've been stuck on island 4 losing to ridiculous RNG such as bad placement and bad archer aim, and then there's the fact that on top of the rng, it's brutally and insanely difficult. The game also touts itself as a strategy game, but there are so few things you can control that any "strategy" to be had is minimal. The worst part is that playthroughs can take like 30 hours EACH doing the same thing on repeat hoping you don't get a bad seed for 5 islands in a row. Again, this would be fine if it wasn't reliant on rng and terrible ai. This review is jumbled, and off the top of my head, so bottom line:

F*** this game.

author: jerryernst
quote: I don't know what they were thinking, but this is 10 steps back from 2. Not only is it greedy on the level of EA. Square Enix, and Blizzard, but it is riddles with gamebreaking bugs and paywalled content.

author: jerryernst
quote: The level of greed present in this game is beyond any sane and rational thought to the point that you would think it was a joke if somebody told you it could cost you 100-200 thousand dollars to fully kit your character. a SINGLE character.

author: jerryernst
quote: This game is one of the most predatory and insulting things square has put out lately, and that's saying something. They may as well have a tutorial in game on how to use your mother's credit card for the kids they're targeting.

author: jerryernst
quote: This game is practically unplayable with the amount of greed packed into it, and literally unplayable with the DRM

author: jerryernst
quote:
Update:
The game has been out for a while and while I was ok continuing with it fr a bit, I'm simly done. Everything is a grind, everything is designed to **** up as much money as possible, and the game does not respect your time. Things have gotten lazier and greedier, and while the game has immense promise, every system in it hampers your enjoyment for that extra dollar (or 1000).

Previous, and still ongoing:
The resin system is a paywall that they don't make obvious until 100+ hours in. I was having a blast until the game basically told me to fms because I didn't have enough resin. But fear not.. you can BUY resin with real money! Ridiculous.

The games simply not worth playing. Watch story online or something.

author: jerryernst
quote: If you're looking for a Doom 2016 experience, this is not it. The gameplay is so asinine and rinse & repeat that I barely want to keep finding imps and zombies to chainsaw for ammo, since the developers thought that would be fun to force players to do. Every new aspect of this game slows down the pacing, and that is not what a sequel to one of the best shooters should be like.

author: jerryernst
quote: First off, I've definitely played this game and beat it. I find the horseracing to be bland, and as it's such a huge part of the game, it's pretty disappointing. The space combat was also pretty terrible if you ask me.

author: jerryernst
quote: I'm honestly surprised WB hasn't found a way to monetize writing reviews by now. $6500 to get everything in the game? This is a mobile game you have to pay $60 for. DO NOT BUY THIS GAME.

author: jerryernst
quote: I am so sick of losing hours of progress in this game because of stupid stuff like bugs or random difficulty spikes. I'm done.

author: jerryernst
quote: The lack of single player is only made more apparent with the repetitive gameplay, and very few modes to change anything up. The roster, while great, is just the same characters we've seen with the addition (and subtraction) of a few characters. The 50+ characters that was going to be an eventual selling point needed to be one now.  There is STILL massive server lag as seen in both betas, and STILL it takes forever to find a match even though there is more players since the beta. This wouldn't be an issue if the matches didn't only last 1-3 minutes. There is no deep customization like the previous 2 titles, which goes against what the series has stood for, and overall the game feels like it has the basis **** game, but the overshadowing of "this is an esports game" really ruins it for me. I was so excited for this game, and I am so sad to be deservingly giving it this low of a score.

author: jerryernst
quote: I'm honestly shocked at the 5% of people who don't believe this game was a masterpiece. This game surpassed what it means to be a game and transcended all genres.
